packageRules.description: npm lockfile regeneration is the most failure-prone artifact update (optional wasm/native deps). Group it separately so one bad artifact cannot strand every other ecosystem's updates.
cargo update regenerates Cargo.lock per workspace; keep it separate from file-edit-only managers for the same blast-radius reason as npm.
macos-26 breaks the .NET MAUI iOS build (default Xcode 26); see https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1627

Android 8.7.0 and iOS 12.15.2 still bundle vulnerable dependencies (shell-quote 1.10.0 in both; axios 1.19.0, brace-expansion 5.0.9, morgan 1.11.0, proxy-addr 2.0.7, sharp 0.35.4 additionally in Android) that npm overrides cannot replace. Update to patched upstream bundles when available; see https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1995

Jest coverage tooling still pulls unpatched sprintf-js through legacy YAML/argparse. Retain updates and verify removal or a fixed upstream release; see https://github.com/bible-on-site/bible-on-site/issues/1996
